title: Vertical structure of a reanalysis Loop Current eddy
query: Using GLORYS temperature, salinity and sea-surface height during 5 August–15 November 2016 in the Gulf of Mexico, identify a resolved anticyclonic Loop Current-region eddy using a documented sea-level criterion. For one clearly documented date, construct a section through its centre and temperature/salinity anomalies relative to an external surrounding region at the same depths. Describe the core's vertical structure. If a separable eddy is not resolved, document this with maps rather than inventing a match to Poseidon. Use only the supplied public data and coordinate-defined masks; no private profiles, author simulations or additional measurements are required. Report methods, executed numerical evidence, a concise interpretation and an editable analysis.ipynb. The reference paper motivates the diagnostic, but its observational values are not target answers for this adapted input.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
